subcategory_text: Data processing ecosystem risk management policies, processes, and procedures are identified, established, assessed, managed, and agreed to by organizational stakeholders.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: SR-1 (Supply Chain Risk Management Policy and Procedures)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.5.19 (Information security in supplier relationships)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 GV.SC-01 (cyber supply chain risk management strategy)
implementation_examples: Document the policies, processes, and procedures used to manage privacy risk across the data processing ecosystem, covering stakeholders (legal, IT, privacy, security, procurement, business)
Obtain stakeholder agreement on the documented approach, refresh periodically, and embed it into vendor onboarding
Adopt recognised supply-chain risk frameworks (e.g., NIST SP 800-161r1) where appropriate
assessment_objectives: Determine whether ecosystem-wide privacy-risk policies and processes are documented
Determine whether the documented approach has stakeholder agreement
Determine whether the approach is embedded into vendor lifecycle processes
Determine whether the approach is reviewed and refreshed periodically
